forum.title: STM32H5 32.6768khz and 24MHz load capacitor values
forum.category: STM32 MCUs Boards and hardware tools
forum.best_answer_content: Simply you require add PCB layout capacity based on layers, material, footprints ...
forum.content_text:
Hi,

I’m using Nucleo-64 development board with STM32H533RE. On the board,

H533:

RTC crystal is Crystal, 32.768kHz, 9pF, +/-20ppm, 70KR, 1.6x1mm and load capacitors are 3.9pF each.

Crystal 24MHz, 6pF, +-20ppm, 80ohms max, SMD, and load capacitors are 6.8pF each.

F723:

on the same board, the STM32F723IEK6, it is Crystal, 24MHz, 6pF, +/-20ppm, 80R, 2x1.6mm and load capacitors are 2.7pF each.

1. should the RTC load capacitor value close to 15pF each?

2. should be 24Mhz load capacitors close to 10pF each?

3. why STM32F7 and STM32H5 24MHz have different capacitor values?

Thank you for your concerns
forum.author: AndyLee

scraped_replies.html:
Hello ​@AndyLee and welcome to the ST community,

Because each crystal have its own characteristics and HSE and LSE have different characteristics.

How to select a compatible crystal and load capacitors for STM32 with layout guidelines

AN2867 “Guidelines for oscillator design on STM8AF/AL/S and STM32 MCUs/MPUs”
